name: Ogre's Monocle
summary: In southern Duskwood, Zzarc'Vul wears a monocle Viktori Prism'Antras needs for a telescope. Its lens has the size and curve to focus light through the stargazing instrument in Darkshire.

sections.title: A Curious Lens
sections.body: Zzarc'Vul, an ogre, wears a monocle made for his massive stature. When Viktori Prism'Antras of Darkshire began building a stargazing instrument from the gnome engineer Cog's blueprints, ordinary lenses proved too small. Zzarc'Vul's eyewear is the only polished glass in the region with the size and curve to focus light through the finished telescope.

sections.title: Prying It from Vul'Gol
sections.body: At the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound in southern Duskwood, Zzarc'Vul lives among his brute brethren. He shows little wish to give up his distinctive accessory. You must defeat him on his own ground to claim the lens, then carry it back to Darkshire so Viktori can turn his gaze to the night skies.

faq.answer: Zzarc'Vul, an ogre, carries the monocle at the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound in southern Duskwood.

faq.q: Why does Viktori Prism'Antras need an ogre's eyepiece?
faq.answer: Viktori Prism'Antras needs an unusually large lens for a telescope built from the gnome Cog's blueprints. Zzarc'Vul's monocle is the only piece of glass in Duskwood that fits.

faq.q: How did an ogre get a giant monocle?
aliases: why does an ogre have a monocle
faq.answer: The account does not explain how Zzarc'Vul acquired the monocle. It says only that he has one large enough for Viktori's telescope.

faq.q: Where is the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound located?
faq.answer: The Vul'Gol Ogre Mound lies in the southern hills of Duskwood, south of the main road between Darkshire and the western border.

angles.text: Cog's blueprint shows typical gnomish ambition: when precision-ground lenses are unavailable in the field, giant eyewear must do.
Recovering the lens removes a dangerous brute from the southern woods and helps Darkshire's beleaguered citizens find solace in the stars.
